scripts.build: node scripts/clean-distribution.mjs && npm run build -w @sql-builder/shared && npm run build -w @sql-builder/web && npm run build -w @sql-builder/api && node scripts/prepare-distribution.mjs && npm install --omit=dev --prefix dist --package-lock=false --bin-links=false
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @sql-builder/shared && npm run dev -w @sql-builder/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @sql-builder/shared && npm run dev -w @sql-builder/web
scripts.electron:make: npm run build && install-electron --no && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --make
scripts.electron:make:windows-arm64: npm run build && install-electron --no && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --windows-arm64 --make
scripts.electron:make:windows-x64: npm run build && install-electron --no && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --windows-x64 --make
scripts.electron:package: npm run build && install-electron --no && node scripts/package-electron.mjs
scripts.electron:package:windows-arm64: npm run build && install-electron --no && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --windows-arm64
scripts.electron:package:windows-x64: npm run build && install-electron --no && node scripts/package-electron.mjs --windows-x64
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.cjs && npm run build -w @sql-builder/shared && npm run test -w @sql-builder/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sql-builder/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sql-builder/web && npm run typecheck -w @sql-builder/api
